quote: Change the unit of work from chain steps to independent simulator runs: amortized simulation-based inference. Draw parameters from a proposal, run the model in massively parallel GPU batches
reason: Eliminates chain iterations the posterior waited on; independent simulations run simultaneously and inference becomes one forward pass.

quote: Change what is measured: target the decision quantity directly — e.g., the posterior of the 1%-exceedance (100-year) flood quantile ... Compute is spent only where it changes the answer.
reason: Changes measurement target and compute allocation; no serial dependency is removed, and active point selection remains sequential.

quote: decompose the record into near-independent hydrologic events (with short warm-ups) plus recession blocks, calibrate each block in parallel ... The serial unit shrinks from decades to days, and blocks are embarrassingly parallel.
reason: Cuts the decades-long timestep dependency into short blocks calibrated simultaneously; the record's serial chain no longer gates the answer.
